connect-grid.looks: A heading and intro above a grid of warm-grey cards: an icon (or a photo across the top), a title, a short description, a divider, then up to four contact lines (a small label above the contact itself, as a link).
connect-grid.use: Ways to reach NCMEC or get help: phone numbers, email addresses, forms.
connect-grid.avoid: Cards with one button and no contact details: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.title: The service or team, e.g. 'CyberTipline'.
fields.icon: A line icon above the title.
fields.image: Optional photo across the top of the card; replaces the icon.
fields.contactMethod1Link: tel:, mailto: or a page, e.g. tel:18008435678.
fields.showDivider: show (default) draws a line between the description and the contact lines.
